title: Workspace Setup
description: A first-run screen: a workspace creation form with a segmented choice, a prefixed URL field and a sample-data option, beside a setup progress card and notification switches. Cards rise, fields and rails are recessed and every solid fill takes one domed finish, all through Actual CSS's relief and finish hooks.
summary: Workspace creation, setup progress and switches, in relief.

remix.name: Paper
remix.description: Warm paper on a dotted desk, hand-drawn card and field edges, handwritten headings, a fountain-pen blue, and a light coloured-pencil hatching as the finish of every solid fill instead of the dome, in light and dark.

notes: Relief and finish are hooks set on .ab-setup: --finish (a background-image over every solid fill), --shadow-control and --shadow-inset. Move them to :root or your theme to give the whole product the same light; delete them for a flat block.
Fields keep the 3:1 --border-control edge, since the recess alone does not identify a field.
Creating the workspace and importing are illustrative. The form posts natively; checking that the URL is free and creating the workspace belong to your application.
The progress card is static: drive the progress value and the step count from your onboarding state.
The switches are native checkboxes with role="switch"; their state is not saved. Persist it with your notification preferences.
